statement: The pinned real-remote path forwards device reports and guest-issued control reports rather than using the independent ControllerInterface initialization ladder. Behavior for a Plus with external MP or two nested MPs depends on game probes and unknown physical responses. Host report forwarding does not establish a second-MP discovery or double gyro acceptance.
